name: Surendranagar Municipal Corporation
headquarters: Near Collector Office, Tower Road, Surendranagar
description: Municipal government for the City of Surendranagar in Surendranagar district, not the entire district. At formation it covered the former Surendranagar-Dudhrej-Wadhwan Municipality and the gram panchayat areas of Mulchand, Chamaraj, Khamisana, Kherali and Malod.
